Commentary.Commentary: With the surface being sluggish, Sri Lanka's slower bowlers reveled. Vandersay with leggies and Gunaratne through his ultra slow medium pacers picked up three wickets apiece to dent the Zimbabwe innings. Wickets falling constantly meant that the hosts were never allowed to get away. This target of 161 is way below par and it could be a walk in the park for the Lankans unless something dramatic happens. Chase starting in 10 minutes.

Poor performance by Zimbabwe after opting to bat. Musakanda and Ervine stitched a solid stand after having lost two wickets early. However, after they were dismissed, nobody really put their hand up barring Williams as wickets fell at regular intervals. The dismissals were more due to loose shots as the track has played decently although slow.

OUT! GUNARATNE WRAPS IT UP! Slow full toss on middle and leg, Vitori is totally foxed on the lack of pace as he goes through with the shot way too early. Misses the line and is hit on the back leg. That's as plumb as it gets and ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 160.
On a length outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Brian Vitori is the last man in. Gunaratne on a hat-trick.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Another one bites the dust! Length ball outside off, Chisoro tries to run it with an open face but gets a feather through to the keeper. It's taken with ease and so we are now down to the last wicket pair. Chisoro was one who could have added some handy runs.

It is a different opening combination for Zimbabwe today. Hamilton Masakadza and Peter Moor are the openers for Zimbabwe. Masakadza on strike to face NUWAN KULASEKARA.

It is time for the national anthems. The Sri Lankan one first up. It is RAINING HEAVILY now and the COVERS are coming on the pitch as well. Hang on... it is a passing shower and the covers go off again. We are now ready for play to begin.

Tharanga says that he would have batted first as well. He reckons that the fast bowlers have a chance in the first 10 overs. Informs that it was a tough decision but they had to leave out Nuwan Pradeep and Shehan Jayasuriya. Dasun Shanaka and Jeffrey Vandersay come in.

Cremer says that it looks a good wicket and should not change much. Also, runs on the board in the final makes a difference. Informs that Brian Vitori and Tarisai Musakanda come into the side today. On the weather, he admits that there will be rain around but it should not hamper the game much.
TOSS - Graeme Cremer spins the coin, Upul Tharanga calls Heads but it is a Tail. ZIMBABWE CHOOSE TO BAT FIRST again.
PITCH REPORT - Pat Symcox says that the pitch looks outstanding. No grass cover or cracks on it and should be a good one to bat upon.
WEATHER - It is pretty overcast and the TOSS WAS DELAYED due to a slight drizzle and wet outfield. However, we should have a 100-over game.

The league games are done and dusted and we are down to the final match of the tri-series. Zimbabwe, to everyone's surprise have made it as one of the qualifiers while the tournament favourites, Sri Lanka will aim to bag another series in their kitty. Hopefully, we have a good game of cricket.
